run_log_mps_to_rerun: run log_mps_to_rerun to replay a VRS file with trajectory, point cloud, eye gaze, and hand tracking data in Rerun
run_log_device_trajectory: run log_device_trajectory to load and log closed or open loop device trajectory files as 3D line strips in Rerun
run_log_point_clouds: run log_point_clouds to load global point cloud files, filter by confidence, downsample, and log as 3D points in Rerun
run_log_eye_gaze: run log_eye_gaze to log eye gaze vectors as 3D arrows and their 2D reprojections on the RGB camera image
run_log_hand_tracking_results: run log_hand_tracking_results to log full hand tracking results including wrist, palm, and finger landmarks in 3D and 2D
